author: Bobby Grayson
description: Before wf/init the spawn case called state_expr on the raw spawn argument, so init/1 bodies were never inspected. After wf/init init_of/2 runs on every module with a def init/1 at translation time (not only spawned ones), so an init with multiple clauses, other statements, a non-{:ok,_} result, free variables, or self() now aborts translation with a message naming Mod.init/1. Modules without init/1 keep the identity default. The builder reports all listed error cases fail with clear messages.
title: Caveat: translator previously ignored init/1 entirely; now any module defining init/1 in an unsupported shape fails translation instead of silently assuming identity
